configurePresets.name: x86-sde-release
configurePresets.description: The default configuration: SDE frontend, optimised, libtorch off (SNIPER_ENABLE_TORCH=ON adds the nn branch predictor and forces the pre-cxx11 libstdc++ ABI).

configurePresets.name: x86-sde-debug
configurePresets.description: Same, unoptimised. Coexists with the release build; -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE now actually rebuilds.

configurePresets.name: riscv-release
configurePresets.description: RISC-V core model with the decoder generated from the UDB (no external dependency); the QEMU front end is built with SNIPER_ENABLE_QEMU.

configurePresets.name: arm64-frontend
configurePresets.description: For the ARM board: builds sift and the DynamoRIO frontend, no x86 simulator. Build with --target dr_frontend; see docs/ARM64.md.
